# Superior Critical (`features:champion-superior-critical`)
**Class:** [Fighter](../classes/fighter.md) | **Subclass:** [Champion](../subclasses/champion.md) | **Level:** [Fighter 15](../levels/fighter-15.md)

Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can now score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18-20 on the d20.
